headline: 2 Solana token mint addresses discovered (1 official, 1 conflicting); no GitHub, audit, or on-chain admin authority data recoverable this run.
short_headline: 2 Solana mints found; admin authority unknown

findings.text: D1: Solscan block-explorer page for bgSoLfRx1wRPehwC9TyG568AGjnf1sQG1MYa8s3FbfY confirms token label 'Bitget Staked SOL (BGSOL)' with total supply ~393,846 BGSOL. Solana is the only chain; no EVM explorers relevant. A conflicting address BGSo18NXTWGtyNa5DBBP1ZCfUFRPWj6bECrPKakn8qN was returned by Solflare search but could not be independently verified this run.

D2: Bitget's official listing announcement (bitget.com/news/detail/12560604590357) is the closest available deployed-contracts page, explicitly listing Contract Address (SOL): bgSoLfRx1wRPehwC9TyG568AGjnf1sQG1MYa8s3FbfY. No standalone 'deployments' docs page was found. The staking events page (bitget.com/events/bitget-sol-staking) serves as product documentation.
D3: No audit links recorded in protocol.audit_links. No audit PDF found via website or search. Zero audit-era addresses surfaced.

D4: No GitHub repository recorded in protocol.github. Search did not surface a public Bitget BGSOL/Solayer repo with deployment artifacts. Solayer's GitHub may contain relevant program code but was not confirmed as the source repository for BGSOL.
D5: Protocol is Solana-only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required. Only one chain's explorer (Solscan) was walked.

D6: No factory contract identified. BGSOL is a single SPL token mint on Solana. DeFiPunkd read-API does not support Solana (chainId not in supported list: 1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111). Factory enumeration via read-API not possible.

D7: Token mint address bgSoLfRx1wRPehwC9TyG568AGjnf1sQG1MYa8s3FbfY classified as role 'token' (BGSOL SPL mint), actor_class 'unknown' (mint authority not read this run). Solayer partnership implies a restaking program acts as mint authority, but this was not verified on-chain.

D8: bgSoLfRx1wRPehwC9TyG568AGjnf1sQG1MYa8s3FbfY traces to the official Bitget listing announcement (evidence[1]) and confirmed by Solscan fetch (evidence[2]). The conflicting Solflare address BGSo18NXTWGtyNa5DBBP1ZCfUFRPWj6bECrPKakn8qN is in unknowns only — not in admin_addresses — as it could not be independently fetched or confirmed.

rationale.verdict: Walked the Bitget website, official listing announcement, Solscan, and staking events page. Two candidate BGSOL mint addresses surfaced (one official, one conflicting/unverified). No GitHub, audit, or on-chain admin authority data was recoverable. DeFiPunkd read-API does not support Solana, blocking on-chain authority reads. Grade is unknown due to inability to confirm mint authority, freeze authority, or Solayer program ID on-chain.

evidence.shows: Bitget's SOL staking product page confirming the product exists, APR range 4.88-5.66%, no lock-up, daily rewards; no contract addresses listed on this page.

Official Bitget listing announcement (2025-02-21) explicitly stating BGSOL contract address on Solana: bgSoLfRx1wRPehwC9TyG568AGjnf1sQG1MYa8s3FbfY. Also confirms BGSOL is a liquidity staking solution by Bitget, trading opened 22 Feb 2025.
Solscan block-explorer confirms token name 'Bitget Staked SOL (BGSOL)', total supply approximately 393,846.29 BGSOL on Solana. On-chain evidence of token existence.

Bitget BGSOL staking events page confirming APR 5.23%, conversion rate 1 BGSOL ≈ 1.16791925 SOL (accumulating rewards), partners listed: Orca (DEX), Save (lending), Solayer (restaking), Kamino (DeFi). No contract addresses listed on this page.

Bitget announcement (Oct 2024) confirming Bitget-Solayer partnership for BGSOL liquid staking launch; staking rewards reflected in increasing BGSOL exchange rate rather than direct deposits; initial yield 8.15%.
Bitget's own 'what is BGSOL' page corroborating contract address bgSoLfRx...8s3FbfY on Solana and describing BGSOL as an LST introduced in collaboration with Solayer.

protocol_metadata.about: Bitget SOL (BGSOL) is a liquid staking token (LST) on Solana, launched by the Bitget exchange in October 2024 in partnership with Solayer, a Solana restaking network. Users stake SOL on Bitget and receive BGSOL tokens representing their staked assets plus accruing rewards; staking yield (~5% APR) is reflected in a rising BGSOL/SOL exchange rate updated every 2–3 days (each Solana epoch) rather than as direct reward distributions. BGSOL can be transferred, traded, or used in DeFi protocols (Orca, Kamino, Save) while continuing to accumulate staking rewards, and can be redeemed for SOL at any time with approximately a 4-day unbonding period.
